card.name: Words right after a person is introduced
card.fires_on: Words just after a person or role noun in general web prose, such as 'this man', 'a speaker', 'who served', 'throughout her'. The word often leads into what that person said or did.

modes.label: Person noun
modes.description: A person or role noun such as man, classmate or speaker, just before a possessive or a verb about them.
modes.example: you've more than likely heard this<< man>>'s name.

modes.label: Verb after a person
modes.description: A verb that follows a named or described person and starts a statement about their actions.
modes.example: Theodor Heuss, who<< served>> as the first president of the Federal Republic

modes.label: Pronoun or article in a person description
modes.description: A small word such as her or a inside a sentence about a person's life or work.
modes.example: Carson continued to write throughout<< her>> life, leaving behind a wealth of scientific

card.plain: It fires on words that come right after someone is mentioned, as the text moves on to describe what that person did.
